decided: 2026-09-12/13, Ben: the published and Query pages show each provision as the review page does today -- small tables of coded headline conclusions (pills) per subject, with the verbatim layered facts (FACT_COMPONENTS/V2) as evidence beneath. contracts/product/table-shapes.v3.json is the table and vocabulary data this layer renders against.
purpose: A fact may carry one additional, optional layer: conclusions, a coded readout of the fact against one table-shapes.v3.json table. Conclusions never state anything the fact's own components do not already state; every coded, valued or verbatim cell cites the component(s) that support it, and a value cell's value is parsed by code from the cited component text, never invented or restated by the model.

fields.table_key: the contracts/product/table-shapes.v3.json table this readout targets; must belong to a section whose v2_family_keys includes the fact's family_key
fields.row_label: the subject as that table names it, e.g. 'RSUs' or 'Base salary': one of the table's fixed_row_labels (or additional_fixed_row_labels) for a fixed-list table, or the fact's own subject term for a one-per-subject table
fields.cells: array of cell objects, at most one per column_id; a column the fact says nothing about simply has no cell -- the page shows a dash for it, nothing is invented to fill it

fields.column_id: one of the resolved table's columns[].column_id
fields.code: for a column with render 'vocabulary': one of that column's vocabulary codes (its own vocabulary, or the shared vocabulary named by vocabulary_ref)
fields.value: for a column with render 'value': { canonical, unit }, parsed by code (parseComponentValue in lib/product/fact-components.js) from a cited component's verbatim text -- never asserted by the model and never invented
fields.text: for a column with render 'verbatim' or 'term': the exact verbatim text of a cited component -- never paraphrased, normalised or newly worded
fields.present: for a column with render 'boolean': true or false
fields.component_ids: component_id values, all drawn from this same fact's own component tree; at least one is required. A cell can never cite a component belonging to another fact. The column's fill_from kinds are the hint for which components usually carry the answer (and for rendering a fact that has no conclusions); a cited component of another kind is accepted.

cell.one_content_field: a cell carries exactly one of code, value, text or present, matching its column's render kind

rules: C1 A cell's column_id must name a column of the fact's resolved table (table_key, checked against the fact's family_key through table-shapes.v3.json section.v2_family_keys).
C2 A 'vocabulary' cell's code must be a code in that column's vocabulary (own or shared via vocabulary_ref); an unknown code is a problem and holds the fact.
C3 A 'value' cell's value must equal parseComponentValue(kind, text) of at least one cited component; the model never states a value column's canonical number or unit itself.

C4 A 'verbatim' or 'term' cell's text must be the exact text of at least one cited component, or a contiguous run of words cut from one cited component's exact text; no paraphrase, normalisation or added words.
C5 A 'boolean' cell's present is a plain boolean; still cites the component(s) that show presence or its stated absence.

C6 Every cell cites at least one component_id from the same fact's own components tree. A component_id absent from the fact's tree is a problem. fill_from is advisory: it says which kinds usually carry the answer and drives the no-conclusions fallback rendering, and a cited component of another kind is not a problem (Metsera V9, 2026-09-13: the single-kind lists held every closing-mechanics fact).
C7 A cell may be absent for any column; the page renders a dash. Nothing is invented to populate every column.
C8 row_label must be legal for the resolved table: one of fixed_row_labels/additional_fixed_row_labels for a fixed-list table; the fact's own subject term for a one-per-subject table.

C9 conclusions is optional on every fact; a fact with valid components and no table shape for its family carries no conclusions and no problem. A fact whose family does have a table shape but whose conclusions are missing is not held -- it is a coverage note, not a validation failure (CONCLUSIONS_MISSING).
